description: Same blog post voice, but every figure and the anecdote come with their basis in the text (78 of 112 shops answering a named call, a named owner, her own books). Specifics the author supplied and backed are not reflexive decoration, so the right answer is no edit and no question about the figure.
prompt: Check post.md for AI-sounding phrasing and fix whatever needs it. It goes on the shop blog. Save the result to out/post.md.

files.post.md: Nearly 70% of small bike shops still price used parts by hand: 78 of the 112 shops in the Leeds trade directory that answered our March call said so. I think that is a mistake, and at Spoke & Chain we moved to a lookup sheet in April. Marta Okoye, who runs Okoye Cycles on Kirkgate, told me on 14 May that she had not changed a price since 2019. Her margins on used parts fell from 31% to 24% over that time, according to her own books.
